Perfect! I found the issue. The logs clearly show that starting at 03:02:44 on May 22, Prometheus is encountering "no space left on device" errors when writing to the Write-Ahead Log (WAL). This explains the dashboard gaps since around 03:00 - Prometheus cannot write new metrics to disk.

Let me search the Kubernetes documentation to understand the persistent volume situation better:
